intents.name: book_token
examples: How do I book a token?
How to get a token number?
I want to book an appointment
How can I register for a queue?
How do I get in line to see a doctor?
Steps to book a doctor appointment
How to schedule a visit to the hospital
intents.response: To book a token, open the app and tap 'Book Appointment'. Select your preferred hospital, then choose a doctor or specialization. Pick the type of visit — First-Time, Follow-Up, or Show Report — then confirm your booking. Your token number will appear immediately, along with your estimated wait time. You will also receive a notification when your turn is approaching.

intents.name: cancel_token
examples: How do I cancel my token?
I want to cancel my appointment
How to cancel a booking
Can I cancel my queue token?
I need to cancel my visit
How do I remove myself from the queue?
Cancel my hospital appointment
intents.response: To cancel a token, go to 'My Appointments' in the app, find the appointment you want to cancel, and tap the 'Cancel' button. Please cancel as early as possible so the slot can be offered to another patient. Tokens cancelled more than 30 minutes before your estimated turn may be eligible for a reschedule without penalty.

intents.name: reschedule_token
examples: How do I reschedule my appointment?
Can I change my appointment time?
I want to change my booking date
How to move my token to another day?
Can I postpone my hospital visit?
How do I change when I see the doctor?
Reschedule my queue number
intents.response: To reschedule, go to 'My Appointments', select the appointment, and tap 'Reschedule'. You can choose a new available slot with the same doctor. Note that rescheduling is subject to doctor availability, and you will receive a new token number for the updated time. You cannot reschedule a token that is already within 15 minutes of its estimated turn.

intents.name: first_time_appointment
examples: What is a first-time appointment?
I am a new patient, how does it work?
What does first visit mean?
Explain the first-time booking option
I have never seen this doctor before
What is a new patient booking?
How do I book as a new patient?
intents.response: A First-Time Appointment is for patients who are visiting a particular doctor for the very first time. When you select this option, the doctor will take a full medical history and conduct an initial assessment. These appointments are typically slightly longer than follow-up visits. If you have never seen the selected doctor before — even if you have visited the hospital previously — choose this option.

Explain the follow-up option
intents.response: A Follow-Up Appointment is for patients who have already consulted a specific doctor and need to revisit for ongoing treatment, test result review, or continued care. Select this option if you have seen this doctor before. Follow-up visits are typically shorter than first-time appointments, as the doctor already has your medical history on file.

intents.response: A Show Report appointment is specifically for patients who have completed diagnostic tests (blood work, X-ray, MRI, ultrasound, etc.) and need to show the results to their doctor for review and further guidance. Choose this option when you already have test results in hand. These are usually short consultations focused on interpreting your reports.

intents.name: wait_time
examples: How is wait time calculated?
How long will I have to wait?
Why is my estimated wait time so long?
How does the app know when my turn will be?
Is the wait time accurate?
How is queue time estimated?
What determines how long I wait?
intents.response: Wait time is calculated based on the number of patients ahead of you in the queue and the average consultation time for that doctor. The app updates your estimated wait time in real time as patients are seen. Factors like no-shows, emergencies, or longer-than-average consultations can affect the estimate. The app will send you a notification when you are approximately 2–3 patients away from your turn.

examples: What does my queue status mean?

Explain the token status
intents.response:
Your token can have one of the following statuses: 
• Waiting — You are in the queue and have not been called yet.
• Active — It is nearly your turn; please be ready at the clinic.
• In Progress — You are currently being seen by the doctor.
• Completed — Your consultation is done.
• Cancelled — You or the hospital cancelled the token.
• Missed — Your turn passed without you checking in; contact reception to rejoin the queue.

Set up push notifications
intents.response: The app sends push notifications to alert you when your turn is approaching — typically when 3 patients are ahead of you. You will also receive notifications for booking confirmations, cancellations, and appointment reminders. To receive notifications, make sure they are enabled for this app in your phone settings. If you are not getting alerts, go to Settings > Notifications in the app and ensure they are turned on.

examples: What if I miss my turn?

My turn passed and I wasn't there
I missed my queue number, what do I do?
What to do when you miss your slot?
Can I rejoin the queue if I missed my turn?
intents.response:
If you miss your turn, your token status will change to 'Missed'. You have two options: 
1. Contact the hospital reception directly — they can often add you back to the end of the queue if there are slots available.
2. Book a new token for the same day (if the doctor still has available slots) or for a future date.
To avoid missing your turn, make sure notifications are enabled so you are alerted when you are 2–3 patients away.

You can tap any past appointment to see details and, if the doctor is still available, quickly book a follow-up appointment from the same screen.

intents.response: To contact a hospital's reception, go to the hospital's profile page in the app and tap 'Contact'. You will find the main phone number, WhatsApp contact (where available), and email address. You can also tap 'Call Reception' to dial directly from the app. For urgent issues at the hospital, always speak with reception staff in person or call their number directly.

intents.name: troubleshooting
examples: The app is not working
App keeps crashing
I can't log in to the app
The app is showing an error
My booking is not going through
App is very slow
I am having trouble using the app
intents.response:
Sorry to hear you are having trouble! Here are some steps to try:
1. Check your internet connection — a stable connection is required.
2. Force-close the app and reopen it.
3. Make sure you have the latest version installed (check your app store).
4. Clear the app cache in your phone settings.
5. Restart your phone.
If the problem persists, please contact our support team via the 'Help & Support' section in the app, or email support@hospitalqueue.app with a description of the issue.
